items.title: 召唤仪式意外翻车
items.prompt:
请绘制一幅充满喜剧效果的画面：附图中的角色举行了一场盛大的召唤仪式，却意外召唤出了令人意想不到的东西。

[角色]
保留原有的面部特征、发型、基础配色和性格特点。根据当前场景调整表情与动作。

[召唤物]
不要照搬示例或候选物品，请为本次场景原创一个全新事物。要与宏大的仪式形成强烈反差，仅凭画面就能让人一眼看出召唤出了什么，并让观众忍不住吐槽“为什么要召唤这个？”。避免局限于与角色外貌或服装直接相关的物品，大胆尝试出人意料的组合。

[场景构图]
分别从不同角度确定召唤物及其大小与状态、角色的反应以及对周围环境的影响，然后将这些元素串联成一个逻辑通顺的完整事件。角色的反应不要只停留在“惊讶”上，要通过表情和肢体动作体现出他与召唤物之间的互动关系。

[表现手法]
让仪式过程显得真实且宏大，利用它与召唤物出现时的巨大落差来制造笑点。核心笑点只保留一个，通过道具和配角的布局来强化这一效果。不要依赖文字说明，要让角色、召唤物和反应在构图中一目了然。如果本次对话中已经生成过同一项目的图片，请勿重复使用之前的召唤物或笑点，需要另辟蹊径。
tags: 专为 GPT Image 2 设计的幽默召唤仪式提示词。该提

items.title: LEGO 人仔变身
items.prompt:
将上传图片中所有可见的人物转换为逼真的 LEGO 风格人仔玩具，同时保留每个人可识别的身份、发型、服装、颜色、配饰、相对身高、姿势以及彼此之间的关系。

格式锁定 — 不可协商
垂直 3:4 宽高比。
全身产品构图。
所有人仔必须从头到脚完全可见。
不要生成方形、横向、宽屏、特写、裁剪或半身构图。

人数锁定 — 不可协商
检测上传图片中所有可见人物。
如果有 1 个人，创建 1 个 LEGO 风格人仔。
如果有 2 个人，创建 2 个 LEGO 风格人仔。
如果有 3 个或更多人，创建相同数量的 LEGO 风格人仔。
不要移除、合并、忽略、重复或替换任何人物。
参考图像中可见的每个人都必须作为独立的 LEGO 风格人仔出现。

参考锁定 — 不可协商
使用上传图片作为所有主题的唯一参考。
尽可能在简化的 LEGO 人仔风格中保留每个人可识别的面部特征。
保持每个人的发型和发色，并将其调整为模塑的 LEGO 风格塑料发件。
保留每个人的面部表情、服装颜色、服装设计、可见图案、配饰和造型。
最终的人仔必须清晰地代表被转化为 LEGO 风格玩具形式的同一个人物。
不要创建通用的人仔。
不要重新设计服装或发明新的配饰。

服装细节锁定
尽可能准确地以 LEGO 人仔形式重现每个人的服装。
保留确切的服装调色板、层次结构、服装类型、领口形状、领线、袖子、夹克形状、裤子或裙子样式、鞋子、可见图案、接缝、纽扣、拉链、腰带、标志、珠宝、包袋、眼镜、帽子和配饰。
将真实服装转化为带有干净玩具风格线条的印刷 LEGO 躯干和腿部图形。
外套应呈现为模塑或印刷的 LEGO 风格服装细节。
鞋子应简化为 LEGO 脚/腿印花，同时保持原始颜色和风格。
不要用通用的 LEGO 服装替换服装。
不要过度简化服装以至于失去原始造型。

群体构图
保持与上传图片相同的人数。
保留主体之间的关系。
保留相对身高差异。
保留基本姿势方向和肢体语言。
如果参考图显示一对情侣，创建匹配的 LEGO 风格情侣。
如果参考图显示一个团体，将整个团体创建为独立的人仔。
以干净的产品风格构图自然地将人仔排列在一起。

LEGO 人仔结构
对每个人仔使用真实的 LEGO 风格比例。
圆柱形头部。
简化的印刷面部特征。
块状躯干。

items.promptZh: 这是一幅异想天开的奇幻油画，描绘了一艘形状像猫的巨大飞行轮船，在清澈的蓝天和柔和的粉红色云彩下漂浮在明亮的海洋上。从左前方的低角度四分之三视图中，这艘船占据了构图的主导地位，使其感觉具有纪念性和空中感。它的船体是圆形和球根状的，就像齐柏林飞艇的混合体，漆成淡粉色和淡紫色，带有温暖的桃色亮点，船头被雕刻成一只毛茸茸的猫的脸，它有淡粉色的皮毛、尖尖的耳朵、明亮的蓝眼睛、小鼻子和一张张开的大嘴，嘴里排列着锋利的黑色牙齿，就像一个奇怪的头像下颌入口。华丽的镀金黄铜装饰、金丝细工、栏杆、管道、铆钉、阳台、舷窗、悬挂装饰品和装饰性机械配件覆盖着这艘船。 4 个高大的烟囱从顶层甲板升起，每个烟囱都带有温暖的铜色、红色和金色条纹，释放出浓浓的棉花糖粉红色烟雾，如画般地盘旋在天空中。上层甲板上充满了错综复杂的维多利亚时代蒸汽朋克细节、圆顶、尖塔、灯状尖顶、微小的结构，以及前面附近的一个小金猫雕像。船腹下方悬挂着一个悬挂式吊舱或平台，上面有微小的可见机械和红橙色底座。远处，三艘较小的船只出现在波涛汹涌的青色水面上的地平线附近，增强了规模。下面的大海描绘着活泼的波浪和白色的泡沫。采用富有想象力的故事书蒸汽朋克美学，丰富的厚涂笔触、可见的绘画质感、灿烂的阳光、浪漫柔和的色彩以及让人想起梦幻般的海上航行的梦幻情绪。垂直构图，高度细致，神奇，超现实，优雅，俏皮。
items.prompt: A whimsical fantasy oil painting of a gigantic flying steamship shaped like a cat, drifting above a bright ocean under a clear blue sky filled with soft pink clouds. The vessel dominates the composition in a low-angle three-quarter view from the front-left, making it feel monumental and airborne. Its hull is rounded and bulbous like a zeppelin-ship hybrid, painted pastel pink and lavender with warm peach highlights, and the bow is sculpted into the face of a fluffy cat with pale pink fur, pointed ears, luminous blue eyes, a small nose, and a huge open mouth lined with sharp dark teeth like a bizarre figurehead-jaw entrance. Ornate gilded brass trim, filigree, railings, pipes, rivets, balconies, portholes, hanging ornaments, and decorative mechanical fittings cover the ship. There are 4 tall smokestacks rising from the top deck, each striped in warm copper, red, and gold, releasing thick cotton-candy pink smoke that curls painterly into the sky. The upper deck is crowded with intricate Victorian steampunk details, domes, spires, lamp-like finials, tiny structures, and a small golden cat statue near the front. A suspended gondola or platform hangs beneath the belly of the ship with tiny visible machinery and a reddish-orange base. In the distance, 3 smaller ships appear near the horizon over choppy teal water, reinforcing the scale. The sea below is painted with lively waves and white foam. Use an imaginative storybook steampunk aesthetic with rich impasto brushstrokes, visible painterly texture, glowing sunlight, romantic pastel colors, and a dreamlike mood reminiscent of a fantastical maritime voyage. Vertical composition, highly detailed, magical, surreal, elegant, and playful.

One child is buying snacks at the counter, several are waiting, and others are chatting near the gate. In the deeper left background, show exactly 5 additional villagers and students moving along the lane, including at least 2 people with bicycles. The shop display should feel crowded and believable: clear plastic jars of candy and snacks on the counter, small packaged treats, exercise books and stationery, hanging goods inside the dark doorway, a wooden shelf at right with snacks and daily necessities, and stacked crates of bottled soda on the ground. items.title: 法文笔记手账俯瞰图
items.promptZh: 一张逼真的头顶生活方式照片，一张开放式笔记本躺在深色木桌上，在柔和的自然室内光线和温暖的中性色调下拍摄。这本笔记本占据了大部分框架，垂直居中，打开两页，上面有整齐的黑色手写法语笔记、随意的圆形笔迹、轻微的瑕疵、一些涂鸦和一些划掉的线条。显示笔记本底部中心悬挂的黑色丝带书签。在左上角加入部分浅色书籍或纸张，并从右上角进入部分白色杯子。页面应呈奶油色，带有微弱的水平线和微妙的中心折痕。在左侧页面上，在顶部附近写下带下划线的标题“计划文章博客”，然后是 6 个项目符号项目：“Écris intro + pourquoi j’ai lancé le blog”、“10 idées reçues sur le miniisme”，其中数字 10 圈起来、“Maroutine du matin (version réaliste)”、“Témoignages / retours lecteurs”、“Outils que j’utilise au quotidien”，并划掉一行，写着“bons plan (liens affiliés)”。在左页下方，添加带下划线的副标题“Idées à creuser :”，后跟 3 个项目符号项目：“article sur les achats impulsifs”、“parler d’argent sans tabou”，附近有一个小星星涂鸦，以及“digital declutter : par où starter ?”，再加上在其下方另外一条完全划掉的手写线。在左下角，绘制一个大的云形轮廓，其中包含文本“Objectif : publier 2x/mois et rester authentique !”并在左页右下角附近添加一个小心形涂鸦。在右页上，在顶部写下划线标题“Routine matin idéale”，然后正好 6 个时间表行：“6h30 : réveil (sans tel !!)”、“6h40 : eau citron + 呼吸”、“6h50 : 10 分钟讲座”、“7h05 : écriture / 感谢”、“7h20 : 运动/瑜伽/游行”、 “7h45：冲洗 + 准备”，然后是“8h15：聚焦 boulot”，右侧有手绘的星星涂鸦。在其下方，添加带下划线的副标题“Pensées du jour :”和 3 行引用：“La纪律，c'est choisir entre”，“ce que tu veux maintenant et”，“ce que tu veux vraiment。”，下面有一个小心形涂鸦。在右下角添加带下划线的副标题“À ne pas oublier :”，后跟 3 个项目符号项目：“appeler la banque”、“prendre rdv médecin”和划掉的“annuler abo salle (trop cher)”。保持构图干净、简约且可信，就像从上方随意拍摄的真实生产力日记或博客规划笔记本一样。
items.prompt: A realistic overhead lifestyle photo of an open lined notebook lying on a dark wooden desk, shot in soft natural indoor light with warm neutral tones. The notebook fills most of the frame and is centered vertically, opened to two pages with neat black handwritten French notes, casual rounded handwriting, slight imperfections, a few doodles, and some crossed-out lines. Show a black ribbon bookmark hanging from the bottom center of the notebook. Include a partial stack of pale books or paper at the top left edge and a partial white mug entering from the top right corner. The pages should look cream-colored with faint horizontal ruling and a subtle center crease. On the left page, write the underlined heading "Plan articles blog" near the top, followed by exactly 6 bullet items: "Écris intro + pourquoi j’ai lancé le blog", "10 idées reçues sur le minimalisme" with the number 10 circled, "Ma routine du matin (version réaliste)", "Témoignages / retours lecteurs", "Outils que j’utilise au quotidien", and one crossed-out line reading "bons plans (liens affiliés)". Lower on the left page, add the underlined subheading "Idées à creuser :" followed by exactly 3 bullet items: "article sur les achats impulsifs", "parler d’argent sans tabou" with a small star doodle nearby, and "digital declutter : par où commencer ?", plus one additional fully crossed-out handwritten line beneath them. At the bottom left, draw a large cloud-shaped outline containing the text "Objectif : publier 2x/mois et rester authentique !" and add a small heart doodle near the lower right corner of the left page. On the right page, write the underlined heading "Routine matin idéale" at the top, then exactly 6 schedule lines: "6h30 : réveil (sans tel !!)", "6h40 : eau citron + respiration", "6h50 : 10 min de lecture", "7h05 : écriture / gratitude", "7h20 : sport / yoga / marche", "7h45 : douche + préparation", and then "8h15 : focus boulot" lower down with a hand-drawn star doodle to its right. Beneath that, add the underlined subheading "Pensées du jour :" and the quote across 3 lines: "La discipline, c’est choisir entre", "ce que tu veux maintenant et", "ce que tu veux vraiment.", with a small heart doodle below. At the bottom right, add the underlined subheading "À ne pas oublier :" followed by exactly 3 bullet items: "appeler la banque", "prendre rdv médecin", and a crossed-out "annuler abo salle (trop cher)". Keep the composition clean, minimal, and believable, like an authentic productivity journal or blog planning notebook photographed casually from above.

1 small circular indicator button with a single orange dot in the center; 1 pill-shaped plus-minus control with a teal minus on the left and teal plus on the right separated by a vertical divider; 1 long horizontal volume slider with a teal speaker icon on the left, fine slider ticks, a teal track, a teal knob near the right side, and a faint waveform icon on the far right; items.promptZh: 这是一张纪实风格的照片，拍摄的是{argument name="country" default="Spain"}一家人在 90 年代朴素的家庭厨房里吃午饭，垂直拍摄，温暖的自然光和逼真的生活细节。四个人围坐在一张小方桌旁：左侧前景中的一名成年男子主要从后面和侧面看到，一名中年妇女集中在桌子的另一侧，用勺子提供食物，桌子右侧有一个十几岁的男孩，右侧前景中是一个扎着马尾辫的年轻女孩，从后面的四分之三视角看。气氛是亲密的、普通的、怀旧的，而且毫无疑问是真实的，就像一张家庭快照，而不是一个舞台商业形象。桌子上铺着蓝白相间的格子桌布，摆着一顿质朴的家常饭菜：1个黑锅，中间放着炖肉或红烧肉，1个木碗，里面装着几片面包，2个小玻璃瓶，里面装着深红酒，多个盘子，里面有食物、餐具、水杯和撕碎的面包片。厨房背景应该感觉真实且略有磨损：奶油色墙壁，墙壁中间有一条带小图案的瓷砖，左边一扇打开的窗户让柔和的日光照射进来，窗台上有 1 个小盆栽植物，1 个木制壁架，用来放置罐子和厨房容器，1 个复古挂历，上面写着 {argument name="month on calendar" default="AGOSTO"}，右边是深色木制家具。使用柔软的胶片般的颗粒、柔和的色彩、轻微的雾气、温和的对比度以及 20 世纪 90 年代模拟照片的典型自然瑕疵。构图应该给人一种从靠近桌子的站立高度随意观察的感觉，前景中有父女的部分遮挡，没有精美的造型，没有库存照片的清洁，只是{argument name="decade" default="1990s"}的日常生活。
items.prompt: A candid documentary-style photograph of a {argument name="country" default="Spain"} family having lunch in a modest 1990s home kitchen, shot vertically with warm natural light and realistic lived-in detail. Four people sit around a small square table: an adult man in the left foreground seen mostly from the back and side, a middle-aged woman centered on the far side of the table serving food with a spoon, a teenage boy on the right side of the table, and a young girl in the right foreground with a ponytail, seen from behind in three-quarter view. The mood is intimate, ordinary, nostalgic, and unmistakably real, like a family snapshot rather than a staged commercial image. The table is covered with a blue-and-white plaid tablecloth and set with a rustic home-cooked meal: 1 black pan of stew or braised meat in the center, 1 wooden bowl filled with several pieces of bread, 2 small glass carafes containing dark red wine, multiple plates with food, cutlery, drinking glasses, and torn pieces of bread. The kitchen background should feel authentic and slightly worn: cream walls, a band of small patterned ceramic tiles across the middle of the wall, an open window on the left letting in soft daylight, 1 small potted plant on the windowsill, 1 wooden wall shelf holding jars and kitchen containers, 1 vintage wall calendar reading {argument name="month on calendar" default="AGOSTO"}, and dark wooden furniture on the right. Use soft film-like grain, muted colors, slight haze, gentle contrast, and natural imperfections typical of a 1990s analog photo. Composition should feel casually observed from a standing height near the table, with partial occlusion by the father and daughter in the foreground, no polished styling, no stock-photo cleanliness, just everyday family life in {argument name="decade" default="the 1990s"}.

items.promptZh: {argument name="time period" default="1990s"} 拍摄的{argument name="location" default="Spain"}海滩场景，采用彩色胶片拍摄，垂直构图，就像真实的家庭快照。夏季正午阳光下的拥挤城市海滩，前景是温暖的米色沙滩，右侧是平静的蓝色大海，背景是海湾对面一长排密集的公寓楼和低矮的山丘。在前景中央，一位赤裸上身、黑发的中年男子坐在毛巾上，背部部分朝向镜头，穿着亮蓝色泳裤，放松且略显无精打采。他周围是 {argument name="number of kids" default="3"} 个小孩子在沙子里玩耍，其中一个穿着红色泳裤站在旁边，两个穿着浅色泳衣坐在附近。将沙滩毛巾、冷却器、袋子、凉鞋和个人物品撒在沙滩上。正好包括 3 把显眼的沙滩伞：1 把彩色花卉伞在左边，1 把红白条纹伞在中左附近，1 把纯粉色伞在右边。中场充满了许多日光浴者和游泳者，他们摆出自然、不做作的姿势，唤起人们日常生活的夏日生活，而不是旅游广告。画面氛围怀旧、普通、真实，带有轻微的胶片颗粒、柔和的褪色、轻微的雾霾以及 20 世纪 90 年代消费相机的不完美现实主义。纪实摄影、零库存照片打磨、可信的肤色、杂乱的海滩环境、自发的构图、微妙的复古印刷纹理。在右上角添加一个小型现代应用水印：{argument name="watermark text" default="Pollo AI"}。

items.promptZh: 一张偷拍的家庭快照，风格类似于 {argument name="year" default="2008"} 左右的消费者数码相机照片，展示了一个中国三口之家在春天的一个公园里紧密地合影。母亲在左边，蹲着，身体前倾，深色图案上衣外罩紫色开衫，蓝色牛仔裤，背着黑色单肩包。孩子位于中间，站立或半蹲在父母中间，身穿海军蓝拉链夹克，袖子有白红条纹，胸前有大号“86”印花，下身搭配橄榄色或棕色裤子。父亲在右边，蹲在孩子身边，穿着黑色长袖衬衫、蓝色牛仔裤、手表和带有可见肩带的灰色背包。三个人紧紧地靠在一起，看着镜头，摆出了典型的休闲家庭合影姿势。将它们放在一条轻石走道上，旁边是一个平静的池塘，池塘边有大型装饰性岩石。背景中，郁郁葱葱的绿树和新鲜的树叶、灰瓦屋顶的传统中式凉亭以及沿着小路和桥梁区域散布的三五成群的公园游客。白天的光线柔和明亮，有轻微的薄雾，真实的早春色彩，以及老式紧凑型相机的中等图像质量：对比度略平，轻微模糊，自然噪点，以及真实的傻瓜式快照感觉。在右下角添加黄色数码相机时间戳：{argument name="timestamp text" default="2008/04/26 10:25"}。构图应该感觉像是2000年代末在中国非正式拍摄的真实家庭旅行照片，水平取景，眼睛水平视角，纪实现实主义，没有风格化。
items.prompt: A candid family snapshot styled like a consumer digital camera photo from around {argument name="year" default="2008"}, showing a Chinese family of three posing closely together in a public park in springtime. The mother is on the left, crouching and leaning in, wearing a purple cardigan over a dark patterned top, blue jeans, and carrying a black shoulder bag. The child is in the center, standing or half-squatting between the parents, wearing a navy zip-up jacket with white and red striped sleeves and a large "86" print on the chest, with olive or brown pants. The father is on the right, crouching close to the child, wearing a black long-sleeve shirt, blue jeans, a wristwatch, and a gray backpack with visible shoulder straps. All three are gathered tightly and looking toward the camera in a typical casual family-photo pose. Place them on a light stone walkway beside a calm pond edged with large ornamental rocks. In the background, show lush green trees with fresh leaves, a traditional Chinese pavilion with a gray tiled roof, and small groups of park visitors scattered along the path and bridge area. Lighting is soft bright daytime with slight haze, realistic early-spring colors, and the modest image quality of an older compact camera: slightly flat contrast, mild blur, natural noise, and an authentic point-and-shoot snapshot feel. Add a yellow digital camera timestamp in the bottom right corner reading {argument name="timestamp text" default="2008/04/26 10:25"}. Composition should feel like a real family travel photo taken informally in China in the late 2000s, horizontal framing, eye-level perspective, documentary realism, no stylization.

items.title: 公园家庭游客照
items.promptZh: 一张偷拍的家庭快照，风格类似于 2008 年左右在中国拍摄的消费者数码相机照片，展示了一个三人家庭一起站在中国传统的公园花园里。垂直构图，略显随意的取景，写实而不雕琢。这个家庭由 3 个人组成：左边是父亲，中右是母亲，右边是站在母亲面前的小儿子。父亲身材高大，肩膀宽阔，穿着白色短袖polo衫和浅蓝色牛仔裤，一只手臂搭在母亲的肩膀上。母亲穿着简单的白色短袖上衣和浅米色及膝裙子，以轻松的姿势靠近父亲站着。孩子穿着一件明亮的石灰绿色 T 恤，上面有红色、黄色和蓝色的大型彩色卡通风格图案，以及带有白色侧条纹的深色短裤。他们的表情很中性，摆出一张休闲的公园照片。背景充满了郁郁葱葱的绿树、修剪过的灌木丛、开着黄色和红色花朵的花坛、石头边框，左右边缘有两个可见的中国传统亭阁屋顶。白天的灯光，略显刺眼但自然的夏日午后光线，浓郁的绿色植物，温和的傻瓜相机柔和度，饱和的色彩，轻微的闪光照片感觉，微妙的数码噪点，真实的早期数码摄影外观。在右下角添加橙色数码相机时间戳：{argument name="timestamp" default="2008.05.18 14:32"}。融入了 2000 年代末中国日常家庭的淡淡怀旧之情。面孔应该是通用的、非名人的、普通中国家庭的长相。
items.prompt: A candid family snapshot styled like a consumer digital camera photo from around 2008 in China, showing a three-person family standing together in a traditional Chinese park garden. Vertical composition, slightly casual framing, realistic and unpolished. The family consists of 3 people: a father on the left, a mother in the center-right, and a young son standing in front of the mother on the right. The father is tall and broad-shouldered, wearing a white short-sleeve polo shirt and light blue jeans, with one arm resting around the mother’s shoulder. The mother wears a simple white short-sleeve blouse and a light beige knee-length skirt, standing close to the father with a relaxed posture. Background filled with lush green trees, trimmed bushes, flowerbeds with yellow and red flowers, stone borders, and 2 visible traditional Chinese pavilion roofs at the left and right edges. Daytime lighting, slightly harsh but natural summer afternoon light, strong greenery, mild point-and-shoot camera softness, saturated colors, slight flash-photo feel, subtle digital noise, authentic early digital photography look. Add an orange digital camera timestamp in the bottom right corner reading {argument name="timestamp" default="2008.05.18 14:32"}. items.title: 泰迪熊版创造亚当
items.promptZh: 这是一幅异想天开的高细节油画，模仿米开朗基罗的《创造亚当》，但所有人物都被泰迪熊取代。左边，一只毛绒泰迪熊斜坐在岩石斜坡上，摆出亚当的姿势，有着柔软的金棕色卷毛、圆耳​​朵、闪亮的黑眼睛、黑色的小鼻子和微张的嘴巴。它的左臂支撑着身体，右臂向外伸展，食爪伸向另一只熊。在右边，一只更大的泰迪熊摆出上帝般的姿势，从深红紫红色的旋转斗篷中出现，穿着一件飘逸的白色长袍，身体向前倾，伸出一只手臂，尖爪伸向左边的泰迪熊，几乎碰到指尖。披风内的长袍熊周围还有 8 只较小的泰迪熊，紧紧地聚集在一起，从不同的角度窥视，就像侍者的身影。该构图完全呼应了标志性的近触双手场景，指尖之间的间隙居中。使用温暖米色色调的裂纹壁画墙背景、柔和的文艺复兴调色板、柔和的定向光、逼真的织物褶皱、细致的毛绒纹理、微妙的阴影和博物馆品质的涂漆表面。将古典文艺复兴时期的壁画美学与迷人的超现实幽默融为一体，使场景保持优雅而不是卡通化。
items.prompt: A whimsical high-detail oil-painting parody of Michelangelo’s Creation of Adam, but all human figures are replaced by teddy bears. On the left, a single plush teddy bear sits reclined on a rocky slope, posed like Adam, with soft golden-brown curly fur, round ears, shiny black eyes, a small dark nose, and a slightly open mouth. Its left arm supports its body while its right arm stretches outward, index paw extended toward the other bear. On the right, a larger central teddy bear posed like God emerges from a deep reddish-burgundy swirling mantle, wearing a flowing white draped robe, leaning forward with one outstretched arm and pointed paw reaching toward the left bear, almost touching fingertips. Surrounding the robed bear inside the mantle are 8 additional smaller teddy bears clustered tightly together, peeking from different angles like attendant figures. The composition exactly echoes the iconic near-touching hands scene, with the gap between fingertips centered. Use a cracked fresco wall background in warm beige tones, muted Renaissance palette, soft directional light, realistic fabric folds, detailed plush texture, subtle shadows, and a museum-quality painted surface. Blend classical Renaissance fresco aesthetics with charming surreal humor, keeping the scene elegant rather than cartoonish.

items.promptZh: 在干净的白色背景上创建一本打开的古董历史书的方形 1:1 微距摄影图像，其样式就像一本可食用的历史弹出书。这本书很厚，复古，皮革装订，180 度平放。它的页面是老化的羊皮纸，纸张泛黄，边缘磨损，纸张纹理清晰可见。在左页上，展示了丰富但略显凌乱的可可收获物，部分覆盖了印刷文字：正好 5 个深红橙色和棕色色调的完整或分裂的可可豆荚，1 个装满可可粒的木碗，一大片松散的可可豆，破碎的可可壳，小堆可可粒，以及夹在配料中的几片光滑的绿叶。一切都应该感觉有机、丰富、有触觉。在右侧页面上，创建一个完全由巧克力和糖果材料制成的各种瑞士巧克力的大型 3D 弹出式雕塑：正好 8 个可见的黑巧克力、牛奶巧克力和白巧克力混合的巧克力条或条块，排列成花束状的直立结构，后面有 5 个大叶形可可或巧克力叶，底部卷曲的淡巧克力刨花，散落的可可面包屑，以及带有复古标签的包装纸基，上面写着“CHOCOLAT” SUISSE”和较小的文字“Maison de Qualité”。在它旁边，放置了一位 1:35 比例的维多利亚时代巧克力绅士，围着围裙，积极地用双手展示和调整巧克力展示。在右侧页面上以粗体黑色衬线文本打印：“Vevey，1875”。下面是一段关于可可和瑞士巧克力文化的简短褪色草书传说段落。该段落应为：“从可可豆荚简陋的外壳中，诞生了一种优雅的甜点。在瑞士巧克力屋中，可可被提炼成一种珍贵的美味佳肴，在沙龙和家庭中共享，因其舒适、庆祝和甜蜜发明工艺而受到珍视。”灯光柔和、温暖，博物馆灯光集中在打开的书的中心。情绪具有教育意义、异想天开且结构丰富。强调真实感、浅景深、微型世界美学、优质的编辑风格和极高的材质纹理保真度。
items.prompt: Create a square 1:1 macro photography image of an open antique history book on a clean white background, styled like an edible history pop-up book. The book is thick, vintage, leather-bound, and lying open flat at 180 degrees. Its pages are aged parchment with yellowed paper, worn edges, and visible paper texture. On the left page, show an abundant, slightly messy cocoa harvest spread partially covering the printed text: exactly 5 whole or split cacao pods in deep red-orange and brown tones, 1 wooden bowl filled with cacao nibs, a large scatter of loose cacao beans, broken cacao shells, small piles of nibs, and several glossy green leaves tucked among the ingredients. Everything should feel organic, overflowing, and tactile. On the right page, create a large 3D pop-up sculpture of assorted Swiss chocolate built entirely from chocolate and confectionery materials: exactly 8 visible chocolate bars or bar segments in mixed dark, milk, and white chocolate, arranged in a bouquet-like upright structure with 5 large leaf-shaped cacao or chocolate leaves behind them, curled pale chocolate shavings at the base, scattered cacao crumbs, and a wrapped paper base with a vintage label reading “CHOCOLAT SUISSE” and smaller text “Maison de Qualité”. Beside it, place a tiny 1:35 scale Victorian-era chocolatier gentleman in an apron, actively presenting and adjusting the chocolate display with both hands. Print on the right page in bold black serif text: “Vevey, 1875”. Below that, include a short faded cursive lore paragraph about cacao and Swiss chocolate culture. The paragraph should read: “From the cacao pod’s humble shell emerges a confection of elegance. In Swiss chocolate houses, cacao is refined into a treasured delicacy, shared in salons and homes alike, prized for comfort, celebration, and the craft of sweet invention.” Lighting is soft, warm museum lighting focused at the center of the open book. Mood is educational, whimsical, and richly textural. 一幅{argument name="style" default="museum-grade, high-end mural"}，其灵感来自于{argument name="location" default="日光东照宫"}的“哭龙”，画在圆形穹顶天花板上。构图严格居中，从虫眼角度观看，营造出强烈的神圣建筑深度感。

一条气势磅礴的龙从圆顶的正中央出现，它的头向下朝向观众。它的身体、爪子和周围的云朵以旋转运动的方式向外辐射，从中心形成动态的圆形爆炸。

整个场景被包围在穹顶结构内，具有微妙的建筑曲率和微弱的边界线索，进一步强调了仰视头顶空间的沉浸感。

items.prompt: A hyperrealistic close-up documentary photograph of severe salt damage on a weathered concrete parapet wall in winter, shot from a low oblique angle so the wall recedes into the distance along the right side of the frame. The concrete face shows widespread scaling and spalling concentrated across the upper half, with irregular peeling patches exposing coarse aggregate stones of various sizes embedded in the mix. The damaged areas form rough, jagged, map-like shapes with crumbling edges, pitted texture, gray cement paste loss, and black and tan exposed pebbles. Vertical moisture streaks and dirty runoff stains descend toward the base of the wall. The overall palette is cold gray, charcoal, and muted winter white, with soft overcast daylight, shallow atmospheric haze in the distant background, and extremely detailed surface texture. Composition should feel like a civil engineering inspection photo, realistic smartphone or field-camera capture, no people, no text, no labels, no dramatic stylization.

items.prompt: A candid, unprocessed indoor photograph taken with an early 2000s consumer digital camera or cheap film camera. The image features a {argument name="family description" default="cheerful Chinese family of three"} in their {argument name="living room description" default="modest Beijing apartment living room"} circa {argument name="year" default="2003"}. A mother, father, and young daughter (around 6) are captured in a cluttered, genuine setting. The mother is looking up, surprised and smiling, while the father is trying to fix an old VCR player, and the daughter is playing with a colorful toy car on the patterned rug. The shot is clearly spontaneous, taken with poor, natural window light from the right. The composition is off-center, slightly blurry and grainy with muted, washed-out colors and a yellowish tint. In the background, there's a bulky beige TV showing static, a wall calendar from 2003, cluttered shelves with VHS tapes, framed family pictures, a cloth sofa, and maybe a small plant. The perspective is from eye level but feels handheld and shaky. The focus is soft, and the depth of field is shallow, emphasizing the natural moment. Shot with an old Nikon Coolpix or Canon PowerShot, visible digital noise and a time-stamp in a corner. The shot captures a slice of mundane, everyday life, with the daughter's messy hair and toys scattered, creating an authentic, memory-like feel.

items.promptZh: 放置在浅色木桌上的一张白色打印纸的自上而下的真实照片，显示计算机生成的乐谱。页面水平居中，具有轻微的透视和柔和的自然室内照明、最小的阴影和干净的文档打印外观。在顶部中心，以纯无衬线字体打印标题“{argument name="file name" default="kura.mid"} - {argument name="track name" default="CH05 Piano"}”。下面是一个钢琴五线谱系统，以标准的黑色音乐符号呈现，带有高音谱号和 4/4 拍号，设计得看起来像自动转换的 MIDI 摘录，而不是精心雕刻的乐谱。在第一个系统的最左侧，包含乐器标签“CH05 Piano”。在页面上准确显示 5 个水平记谱系统，从系统左边缘的小节编号 18、21、25、29 和 33 开始。在第一个系统附近，包括一个带有等于 120 的四分音符符号的速度标记。在五线谱上填充密集的、有点笨拙但合理的黑色音符、临时记号、符干、连线和休止符，在高音区有许多尖锐的符号和重复的短音符数字，视觉上类似于来自 MIDI 的钢琴转录。前 3 个系统应该是长且接近全宽的；第四个系统也应该很长；第 5 个系统应该很短，仅占据页面的左侧部分。保持符号清晰易读，但有些机械间隔。使用干净的白色页面，页边距宽，没有手写标记，没有彩色元素，没有额外的图形，只有在桌子上拍照的打印分数表。

items.prompt: Using the provided reference image of the mobile app screen, transform it into a premium editorial magazine cover mockup about agricultural innovation. Keep the app UI recognizable on the phone display, but place it in a realistic lifestyle context: a vineyard worker in the foreground holding a smartphone that shows the app, with vineyard rows, mountains, and a few workers in the background under natural daylight. Design the full page as a Spanish-language magazine cover with a refined agricultural-business aesthetic in green, cream, and earthy tones. Add a large masthead at the top reading “REVISTA CAMPO FUTURO”, a thin top strapline with 3 items separated by vertical bars: “Especial Viñas de Chile”, “Innovación agrícola”, and “Abril 2026”, plus a subtitle line beneath the masthead: “Agricultura, innovación y gestión rural”. On the left, add a green section tag reading “TECNOLOGÍA AGRÍCOLA” and a bold stacked main cover headline: “La app con IA que está revolucionando el campo”, followed by a short deck about Kimün replacing the traditional notebook and giving real-time control to vineyards and agricultural businesses. Add a circular callout badge mentioning a special feature about Kimün as an intelligent field notebook with AI. Include 2 bottom teaser photos: one close-up of the worker holding the phone in the vineyard with page label “p.18” and a caption about field diagnosis and cellphone alerts, and one small group scene with 3 people reviewing the app together with page label “p.24” and a caption about connected field teams, voice, records, and instant costs. On the right column, add 3 article teasers with icons and page numbers: one about the end of paper and the new era of the intelligent field notebook (p.30), one about more efficient vineyards through better data-driven decisions (p.36), and one about water management 4.0 and smarter, more profitable irrigation (p.42). Add a footer strip with 5 category labels: “AGRICULTURA”, “FRUTALES”, “VIÑAS”, “GANADERÍA”, “SUSTENTABILIDAD”, plus a barcode and a small price. Make it look like a polished real magazine cover photo shoot and editorial layout, not a flat app screenshot.

items.title: 混沌笔记浮现角色脸
items.prompt:
# 混沌としたメモ書き・記号の集合体からキャラクターの顔を浮かび上がらせるアート

---

## スタイル
- 白い紙の上に黒インクで描かれた大量の手書きメモ、数式、記号、ランダムな線。
- 紙いっぱいに散らばる書き殴り風のカオス。
- 所々に{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}の強調（ライン、塗り潰し、マーカー風の塊）。
- アナログのノート落書きのような質感。

---

## 構図
- ランダムなメモや記号が全体を覆い尽くす。
- 黒インクの線や文字の密度が「キャラクターの顔」の位置に集中する。
- 結果として、混沌の中から「与えられたキャラクターの顔のシルエット・表情」がうっすら浮かび上がる。
- 顔は写実的ではなく、カオスの断片が集まって形を成す。

---

## 色彩
- モノクロ（黒・白）を主体に構成。
- {argument name="アクセント色" default="赤インク"}をアクセントとして散発的に配置。
- 彩度は抑えめ、アナログの紙とインク感を重視。

---

## 表現要素
- 読めるようで読めない文字列、日本語や英数字が混在。
- 数式記号、矢印、点、斜線、クロス、ドリップ（インクの飛び散り）。
- キャラクターの顔の目や髪の輪郭は、メモや記号の配置の「余白」や「濃淡」で浮かび上がる。

---

## 禁止事項
- 顔を直接的に描き込む写実ポートレート。
- デジタル処理的で整然とした幾何学模様。
- カラフルな彩色や過飽和表現。
- ロゴ、透かし、人工的なCG感。

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- 全体は「混沌としたメモ・記号の集合体」として成立している。  
- 与えられたキャラクターの顔が、混沌の濃淡・配置から自然に浮かび上がる。  
- 色はモノクロ＋{argument name="アクセント色" default="赤アクセント"}のみ。  
- 紙とインクの手描き的質感を保持している。

items.title: 极简人物
items.promptZh:
核心理念：
将 Homelander 重画为美国成人动画情景喜剧中的角色（类似于《恶搞之家》、《辛普森一家》或《瑞克和莫蒂》）。

要保留的主要功能：

标志性轮廓：保留特定的发型、标志性调色板、服装轮廓和关键配饰（例如承太郎的帽子头发混合或乔鲁诺的胸部镂空）。

个性：保持角色原有的“氛围”或气质（例如坚忍、华丽或叛逆）。

视觉语言/艺术风格：

线条：粗体、粗的黑色轮廓。

眼睛：白色的大圆形眼睛，黑色的小瞳孔（经典的“瞪眼”或“圆点”眼睛外观）。

特点：高度简化的面部特征和解剖结构。

比例：“大头、简单身体”美感（夸张的卡通比例）。

着色：平面卡通着色，没有复杂的渐变或纹理。

背景：干净、简化的室内环境（例如客厅或厨房）。
items.prompt:
Core Concept:
Redraw Homelander as a character from an American adult animated sitcom (similar to Family Guy, The Simpsons, or Rick and Morty).

Key Features to Retain:

Iconic Silhouette: Keep the specific hairstyle, signature color palette, clothing outline, and key accessories (e.g., Jotaro’s hat-hair blend or Giorno’s chest cutout).

Personality: Maintain the character's original "vibe" or temperament (e.g., stoic, flamboyant, or rebellious).

Visual Language / Art Style:

Line Work: Bold, thick black outlines.

Eyes: Large white circular eyes with small black pupils (classic "googly" or "dot" eye look).

Features: Highly simplified facial features and anatomy.

Proportions: "Big head, simple body" aesthetic (exaggerated cartoon proportions).

Coloring: Flat cel-shading with no complex gradients or textures.

Background: A clean, simplified indoor setting (e.g., a living room or a kitchen).

items.title: 雨夜少女遇巨龙
items.promptZh: 镜头 1 (00:00–00:02) – WS，雨夜，前向跟踪。一条狭窄的古村小巷，被无情的雨淋湿了。水顺着倾斜的屋顶流下来，淹没了凹凸不平的石头小路，反射着闪烁的灯笼光。一名年轻女孩赤脚在水中奔跑，湿透的裙子紧贴着她，努力保持平衡。在她身后，阴影人物不自然地移动——随着每次闪电的靠近而扭曲、拉伸和故障。视觉特效：大雨模拟，反射潮湿的表面，闪电照亮扭曲的阴影。 SFX：雷声炸响，急速飞溅的脚步声，呼啸的风声。镜头 2 (00:02–00:04) – CU、恐慌跌倒、手持设备轻微震动。她突然滑倒，摔在潮湿的石头上。水向外溅出。雨水和泪水紧紧贴在她的脸上，她的呼吸急促而不均匀。她用颤抖的双手撑着地面，试图向后退去，眼睛盯着正在逼近的黑暗。视觉特效：详细的飞溅模拟、运动模糊、镜头水滴。 SFX：心跳加速、呼吸粗重、雨水击打表面。镜头 3 (00:04–00:06) – LS，暴力地面喷发。阴影之下的大地剧烈地裂开。石头在强大的冲击波中向上爆炸，将碎片和水喷射到空中。一条巨龙从下方冲出——它的身体漆黑，身披铠甲，鳞片下脉动着微弱的发光静脉。它从少女与阴影之间升起，瞬间将她们驱散成黑暗的碎片。视觉特效：地面破坏、飞扬的碎片、发光的裂缝、大量的灰尘。 SFX：深沉的撞击声、分层的龙吼声和低音隆隆声。镜头 4 (00:06–00:08) – CU、情感实现、缓慢推进。女孩愣住了，抬起头。她的恐惧开始消退。闪电短暂地照亮了龙的脸——它发光的眼睛平静而专注。那只眼睛的倒影充满了她的眼睛。此刻，雨似乎小了一些。视觉特效：眼睛反射细节、微妙的慢动作雨、龙眼发出的柔和光芒。 SFX：雷声逐渐减弱为低环境音，雨声减弱。镜头 5 (00:08–00:11) – MS，温和交互，静态框架。巨龙慢慢地向她低下巨大的头，动作小心谨慎。它轻轻地碰了碰她的肩膀。水滴滑过它的鳞片，落下时发出微弱的光芒。她犹豫了一下，然后慢慢地将手举向它，紧张感消失了。视觉特效：鳞片下微妙的生物发光脉冲，详细的水相互作用。 SFX：深沉平静的呼吸，柔和的环境嗡嗡声。镜头 6 (00:11–00:13) – LS，保护性机翼扩展。巨龙张开巨大的翅膀，在她周围形成一道防护屏障。雨水猛烈地打在翅膀的外表面，但空间内部却变得静止——干燥、温暖、寂静。外部的混乱与内部的平静之间的对比是直接而引人注目的。视觉特效：翅膀上的雨水偏转，室外的冷蓝色调与温暖的蓝色调
items.sub: 视频模板 - 武侠/历史
items.prompt: Shot 1 (00:00–00:02) – WS, Rainy Night, Forward Tracking. A narrow, ancient village alley drenched in relentless rain. Water streams down slanted rooftops and floods uneven stone pathways, reflecting flickering lantern light. A young girl runs barefoot through the water, her soaked dress clinging to her as she struggles to keep balance. Behind her, shadowy figures move unnaturally—distorted, stretching and glitching with each lightning flash as they close in. VFX: Heavy rain simulation, reflective wet surfaces, lightning illuminating distorted shadows. SFX: Thunder cracks, rapid splashing footsteps, howling wind. Shot 2 (00:02–00:04) – CU, Panic Fall, Slight Handheld Shake. She suddenly slips and crashes onto the wet stone. Water splashes outward. Close on her face—rain mixes with tears, her breath sharp and uneven. Her trembling hands push against the ground as she tries to move back, eyes locked on the approaching darkness. VFX: Detailed splash simulation, motion blur, lens water droplets. SFX: Intensifying heartbeat, heavy breathing, rain striking surfaces. Shot 3 (00:04–00:06) – LS, Violent Ground Eruption. The ground beneath the shadows fractures violently. Stone explodes upward in a powerful shockwave, sending debris and water into the air. A massive dragon bursts from below—its body dark and armored, faint glowing veins pulsing beneath its scales. It rises between the girl and the shadows, instantly scattering them into fragments of darkness. VFX: Ground destruction, flying debris, glowing cracks, volumetric dust. SFX: Deep impact boom, layered dragon roar with sub-bass rumble. Shot 4 (00:06–00:08) – CU, Emotional Realization, Slow Push-In. The girl freezes, looking up. Her fear begins to fade. Lightning briefly illuminates the dragon’s face—its glowing eye calm, focused. The reflection of that eye fills hers. The rain appears to slow slightly in this moment. VFX: Eye reflection detail, subtle slow-motion rain, soft glow from dragon’s eye. SFX: Thunder fades into low ambient tone, rain softens. Shot 5 (00:08–00:11) – MS, Gentle Interaction, Static Frame. The dragon slowly lowers its massive head toward her, movements controlled and careful. It gently nudges her shoulder. Water droplets slide across its scales, glowing faintly as they fall. She hesitates, then slowly lifts her hand toward it, tension leaving her body. VFX: Subtle bioluminescent pulses under scales, detailed water interaction. SFX: Deep calm breathing, soft ambient hum. Shot 6 (00:11–00:13) – LS, Protective Wing Expansion. The dragon spreads its massive wings wide, forming a protective barrier around her. Rain violently hits the outer surface of the wings, but inside the space becomes still—dry, warm, and silent. The contrast between chaos outside and calm inside is immediate and striking. VFX: Rain deflection on wings, cold blue tones outside vs warm

场景
0–2秒

2-4秒

items.promptZh: 16:9横屏，街头说唱MV风格，霓虹紫蓝冷色调，爆炸酷炫氛围。 0-3秒：中景推入，霓虹灯闪烁的城市街道夜景，80岁的银发老妇站在涂鸦墙前，银白短发梳成整齐的光背，方脸轮廓分明，剑眉斜斜鬓角，目光锐利如电，眼角皱纹如时光的徽章，嘴角挂着自信的笑容，身上穿着黑色皮夹克。白色印花T恤（胸前黑色大字“YOLO”）+黑色工装裤+白色高帮运动鞋，脖子上挂着一条粗金链项链，手腕上戴着银色手镯，双手举着麦克风，强劲的BGM鼓点开始，老太太眼神锐利，张开嘴唇开始Rap。 3-7秒：中景+特写切换，老妇人开始说唱，节奏感极强，银发飘扬，点头动作，一手拿着麦克风，另一只手做出配合节奏的手势——食指指向镜头，手掌上下切割节奏，做出嘻哈手势，动作流畅，目光锐利直视镜头，皱纹随着表情跃动，嘴唇快速开合吐出歌词： 【说唱歌词】“八十岁的腿，比你跳得更好！银发飘逸，这是我的骄傲！别说我老，我的Flow比你的好，你在说唱的时候，我在听迪斯科！” （速度快、节奏感强、态度凶猛）快切：面部特写、手部动作、全身摇摆、侧面剪影，与BGM节拍同步。 7-11秒：舞蹈片段，镜头拉回，展现全身，老太婆开始跳舞——先是经典的街舞弹跳，然后是整齐的街舞定格，接着是从肩部传到脚趾的身体波动，然后是快速的步法锻炼，动作干净利落，银发在霓虹灯下飞舞，皮夹克在空中飘扬，她一边跳舞一边继续说唱：【说唱歌词】“腿脚灵活，速度快”不慢，我的歌词刻在时间里！你玩手机，我玩节拍，八十年的人生，写进这句诗！” （节奏更快，基调更强）低角度向上拍摄+360度环绕拍摄，捕捉老妇人酷炫而激烈的舞蹈动作。 11-15秒：高潮结局，老妇人酷酷的转身，银发在空中呈弧度，面对镜头用手指做了一个“嘘”的手势，然后嘴唇靠近麦克风，用低沉磁性的声音唱出最后一句：【现实歌词】“岁月从来不败美人，我只是改变了体验青春的方式……”（节奏缓慢，情感深沉，余韵悠长）镜头慢慢推近，特写镜头老妇人的眼睛、眼角的皱纹都是有故事的，目光依然锐利却又带着一丝慈祥，BGM在高潮处戛然而止，画面定格在老妇人清凉又略带温柔的笑容上，暗角+霓虹紫光晕。

items.promptZh: 经典复古迪士尼动画风格。场景一：海上航行的海盗船上，一个又胖又阴险的鳄鱼海盗站在一块木板的尽头。三名鸟海盗在船上观战，另一名鸟海盗则站在木板的起始处，用剑指着鳄鱼海盗。鳄鱼海盗穿着无袖紧身衣，肌肉发达。他一脸挑衅地看着鸟海贼团。虽然他有些不知所措，但他并不打算放弃。鸟海贼团看着鳄鱼海贼团，露出邪恶的笑容。气氛紧张，鸟海盗希望鳄鱼海盗从木板上跳下海里。场景2：鸟海盗说一切都结束了。他用爪子猛击木板，木板摇晃起来。鳄鱼海盗失去平衡，从木板上摔下来。场景三：鸟海盗们发出邪恶的笑声，却发现鳄鱼海盗并没有倒下。相反，他用一只手抓住木板的末端，手臂伸直。场景四：鳄鱼海盗上半身特写。一只鸟海盗弯下腰，狡黠一笑，伸出一根羽毛，指向鳄鱼海盗抓木板的手臂腋下，说道：“是时候笑一笑了。”场景五：鳄鱼腋下羽毛蠕动的特写，并伴有滑稽的音效。与此同时，我们听到鳄鱼咯咯地笑。场景六：镜头聚焦在悬在空中的鳄鱼上半身，闭着眼睛傻笑着，羽毛继续逗弄它的腋下，发出一声闷笑。场景七：镜头扫过鳄鱼海盗全身；鸟海盗继续挠他的腋窝，很快鳄鱼海盗就开始大笑起来。场景八：这只鸟继续挠鳄鱼海盗的腋窝，让他歇斯底里地大笑。突然，鳄鱼海盗大笑起来，松开了木板，掉进了海里。鸟海盗终于发出一声狡黠的笑声，脸上露出满意的笑容，重新站在了木板上。英文配音。

items.title: 糕点世界杯奖杯
items.prompt: 一张高度细致、电影级的AI生成图像，展示了为2026年世界杯决赛完全由美食糕点重新设计的风格化国际足联世界杯奖杯。球体由紧密排列的奶油色和淡雅色调的法式马卡龙组成，各大洲由平滑的金箔点缀呈现。支撑人物由旋涡状的白色蛋白霜和层层叠叠的金色酥皮点心（类似于牛角面包）雕刻而成。底座是一个由蛋糕、糖霜和马卡龙组成的台阶式结构，带有华丽的金色细节，并有一块写着“THE SWEET CHAMPIONS”的铭牌，上方优雅地刻有“FIFA WORLD CUP 2026”。奖杯坐落在巨大的现代化体育场内一个反光的金白相间底座上，球场内挤满了挥舞着国旗的球迷。底座后方可见草坪，而大屏幕上显示着“FIFA WORLD CUP 2026 FINAL”以及MetLife品牌标识和足联会徽。在夜晚的露天体育场上方，五彩缤纷的烟花点亮了天空，并形成了一个巨大的闪耀烟花展示。
